prompt: How to get an Emirates ID?
actualResponse:
Step-by-Step Guide: How to Get an Emirates ID  The Emirates ID is a mandatory identification card for all UAE citizens and residents. It is essential for accessing government services, opening bank accounts, signing contracts, and more. Below is a clear, step-by-step guide to obtaining your Emirates ID:  1. Ensure You Have a Valid UAE Residence Visa   You must have a valid UAE residence visa before applying for an Emirates ID. This is a strict requirement for expatriate residents3.  2. Prepare Required Documents  The documents needed may vary depending on your nationality and age, but generally include:   Valid passport  UAE residence visa (for expatriates)  Birth certificate (for children)  Passport-sized photographs  Other documents as specified by the ICP (Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security)4.  3. Submit Your Application  You have two main options:   Online:  Apply through the ICP website or the ICP mobile app.  In Person:  Visit an accredited typing centre, where staff will help you fill out the application form and collect the necessary documents13.  4. Pay the Application Fee   Fees vary depending on the validity period of your Emirates ID and your residency status.  Payment can be made online or at the typing centre3.  5. Biometric Data Collection   After submitting your application, you will need to visit an ICP service centre to provide your fingerprints and have your photograph taken.  You can schedule this appointment after your application is submitted3.  6. Application Processing   Once your application is processed, you will receive an SMS notification regarding the status of your Emirates ID3.  7. Collect Your Emirates ID   You can collect your Emirates ID from the designated Emirates Post office, or it may be delivered to your registered address depending on your selection during the application3.  8. Track Your Application (Optional)   You can track the status of your Emirates ID application online via the ICP website or through the typing centre4.  Additional Notes   For urgent cases, UAE and GCC nationals can use the "Fawri" service to obtain an Emirates ID within 24 hours for an additional fee1.  Expatriate residents can use the urgent service only for replacement of lost or damaged cards, not for new applications1.  It is a legal requirement to carry your Emirates ID at all times in the UAE1.  References  1: UAE Government: Emirates ID - Application Process, Requirements, Urgent Service 
2: ICP Official Services Portal - New Identity Card, Renewal, Replacement 
3: First Abu Dhabi Bank Expat Guide: Emirates ID Application Steps
